newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet in talks on Serbia's telecoms - paper.
newsitem.headline: Stet in talks on Serbia's telecoms - paper.

text.p: Italian state telecommunications holding Stet and state operator Telecom Italia are in negotiations with Serbia to modernise its telephone network and manage its telephone service, Il Sole daily newspaper said.

The paper gave no sources for the report but said: "The Stet-Telecom Italia group is negotiating in Belgrade for an operation of a trillion lire which would give it the management of Serb telephones."
This would include the task of modernising "the Yugoslav federation's network through massive investments over several years," it said.
Stet and its majority-owned telephone operating company Telecom Italia are planned to merge this year in preparation for the privatisation of the combined group.
